stage: Step 1, declared before its first life: the emission decision apart from the letter (candidate (c)) on fresh founders, beside the 0.97.0 default and matched gradient baselines.

brain.note: Brain.compose(16, 18, backend='cpu', seed=s, **genes, **arm genes): the 0.97.0 default composition (the recall memory, the heard history of the moment before, the store). The world pays nothing: the reward learner's rates are zero.

split.role: the mechanism: Brain.compose(16, 20, slots=[18, 2]); the first slot taught the symbol heard on every frame of its sound (frames), the second taught 1 at the supplied alignment and 0 elsewhere; the brain says the first slot's symbol where the second says 1

default.role: the 0.97.0 default taught the supplied alignment, the reference

learners: lstm split (the split brain's two targets)
modes: online: one pass at the brain's exposure
offline: shuffled epochs to the stopping rule (patience 3, at most 60)

gates.emission: split, on the stream as said (nothing merged): inserted characters under .02 per reference character and characters at .95, on 5 of 6 founders
gates.words: split: held-out words said whole at .90 on 5 of 6 founders, read beside both CTC baselines
gates.beside: split against default paired by founder on held-out words, characters and the misses after an unseen letter pair; not a gate

stop: One life per process. No setting changes after any life; every life is kept and reported.
